name: archify
tagline_zh: 把模糊需求或零散代码，变成可点击的架构图。支持主题切换、轨迹动画，还能导出多种格式——连真实仓库都能自动核对。
tagline_en: Turn vague ideas or raw code into explorable architecture diagrams with themes, trace motion, multi-format.
desc_en: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. U
why_zh: 不仅画图，还能读仓库验证真实代码；输出独立HTML，交互探索，远超静态图。
why_en: It verifies against your actual repo, not just your description, and outputs interactive standalone HTML—far beyond static.
